Choose a single dark background based on the character color scheme, contrasting warm skin tones with character color blocks. Simple composition, centered, vertical stacking, possessing the vibe of old children's books and mid-20th century book covers. 3:4 portrait aspect ratio, small voxcat signature at bottom right.
